t: The $(5)Speed Module$() can be placed in the upgrade slots of various MFFS machines to upgrade their performance. Its effects vary depending on the machine, but most commonly include: $(li)Speeding up force field projection$(li)Increasing the $(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)Fortron$() transfer limit of a $(l:mffs:machines/fortron_capacitor)Fortron Capacitor$()$(li)Increasing the efficiency of a $(l:mffs:machines/coercion_deriver)Coercion Deriver$()

$(5)速度模块$()可放置在各种模块化力场系统机器的升级槽中，以提升其性能。其效果因机器而异，但通常包括：$(li)加快力场投射速度$(li)提高$(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)力场子$()在$(l:mffs:machines/fortron_capacitor)Fortron 能量储存器$()中的传输上限$(li)提升$(l:mffs:machines/coercion_deriver)Fortron 衍生器$()的效率
